recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Bio: Jason Quitt is a Canadian author and researcher of ancient mysticism, sacred geometry and archaeo-astronomy, and the founder of The Crystal Sun. A graduate of the Institute of Energy Wellness who has studied energy modalities, shamanism and Qi Gong since 2002, he has taught and lectured on mysticism, meditation and out of body experience since 2010. His books include Egyptian Postures of Power, The Yosef Codes, Astral Genesis, Gates of the Anunnaki and Astral Experiences. His latest, The Shining Island: Precession, Axis Mundi, & Plato's Celestial Allegory, reads Plato's Atlantis not as a sunken empire but as a celestial allegory encoding the fall of the pole star and the precession of the Great Year.
recG4mC1e79KaK37p.Name: Jason Quitt

fields.Intro Paragraph 1: A solar-astrological cipher is hidden inside ancient art spanning 12,000 years and every continent on Earth, and your own body is the key that unlocks it. Jason Quitt returns to InnerVerse with the discovery behind his new book Astral Genesis.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Jason Quitt, archaeosymbologist, esoteric researcher, and author of Astral Genesis and Egyptian Postures of Power, returns to InnerVerse to reveal the solar cipher he discovered encoded in ancient art across 12,000 years and every continent. The conversation covers the brazen serpent of Moses as a solar and Kundalini motif rather than a literal snake, Horus the Savior standing in the tetramorph of the fixed zodiac signs, the Hebrew nachash gematria linking serpent, bronze, and Messiah, the bronze age as the age of the serpent under the pole star Thuban, the human body as the cosmic measuring stick through the cubit and the hand as fifteen and twenty-three-and-a-half degrees of sky, Thoth depicted as a living protractor of the Earth's axial tilt, the procession of the zodiac and the solar sine wave winding through the Milky Way, the Egyptian Book of the Dead read as astrotheology, the unified Set-Horus body at the equinox, the first step of the solar code at the Giza plateau where the sun appears to stand on the back of the Sphinx, the Trinity as the three solstice and equinox suns encoded in the three pyramids, and the per-pharaoh cubit as a tonal-center reset that may link ancient Egypt to ancient China.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Chance Tests the Code on Tarot", "body": "The second hour opens with Chance testing Jason's code himself, overlaying the 23.5 and 15 degree angles on the Fool and Sun tarot cards and finding the flower, the dog, the horse's head and the background mountains all landing on solar angles, and Jason allows he cannot say it is wrong. Jason takes it as evidence that the knowledge has never been broken, while Chance offers that inspired artists may reproduce the angles without knowing it. Jason then shares the real tell: in a genuine solar motif, the 23 degree line runs through every single eye in the image, aligning them all to the Eye of Horus."}, {"title": "The Tablet of Shamash Discovery", "body": "Jason walks through how a latitude's winter, equinox and summer sun heights become three nested circles that together look like an eye. He first discovered the ratio on the Babylonian Tablet of Shamash: the rod the seated god holds measures exactly his own elbow to fingertip, a cubit rod, and the circle matches the three solar ratios of Urkesh's latitude, with the royal cubit encoded in the same figure. Chance reads the rod and circle as the one and the zero, the two measures needed to map the cosmos, and Jason shows the same solstice circles building the logos of the solar crescent, Ishtar and Shamash."}, {"title": "Artifacts That Encode Their Own Location", "body": "Jason frames the book's boldest claim as a hypothesis: ancient artifacts encode the latitude where they were made, a GPS readable through the sun. He overlays the solar ratios of 31.3 degrees on the Sumerian eye idols and the summer solstice angle matches their bodies across multiple figures. Göbekli Tepe's Pillar 43 is offset 37.2 degrees, the site's exact latitude, its three baskets sized like the three suns and marked by a nesting bird, a squirrel and a frog for the seasons. A 12,000 year old hamsa from Karahan Tepe fits the ratios of its own latitude, and its 24 degree base angle matches the Earth's tilt of that era."}, {"title": "The Bull Snake and the Seven Chakras", "body": "Chance has Jason read Coffin Text spell 374, where the bull snake swallows his seven uraei, gains seven neck vertebrae, and commands the seven Ennead gods who hear the word of the monarch. Jason identifies the snake as Neheb-kau, the double of Ra who grants the ka at birth and at death, and reads the swallowed serpents as the seven chakras, so that the one who takes them in speaks to the creator gods through the throat, a reading he calls his own. Chance connects the pattern to the opening of the mouth ritual, with Ursa Major as the adze circling the mouth of the heavens at the pole star."}, {"title": "False Doors as Solar Calendars", "body": "Jason lays out the false door: in Egyptian tombs it opens for the spirit on specific dates so the ka can feed and travel, and the same form appears in Peru and Bolivia, including the Gate of the Gods near Lake Titicaca. Read with the solar code the door becomes a calendar, the equinox sun lighting the innermost door, and Inca accounts of a priest carrying the solar disc through the doorway on a set date mirror the stories told in Egypt and Sumeria. Chance adds his three strikes rule of philology, artifact and ritual, and the reversal that turns Inca into Agni, the fire god behind Agnus Dei."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "This knowledge has never been broken, and we can see evidence of it till today.", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If it's a solar motif, that 23-degree line will actually go through every single eye perfectly in that image.", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's so many reasons why these two measurement ratios, the line and the circle, are basically what you would need to map the cosmos.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The funniest thing about biblical teachings is they tell you, \"Don't learn about these things. Don't look here. This is evil. Stay away from this.\" But literally, their book is full of that information.", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If you knew how to read the sun and the sky and read the artifact, then you can actually find the location on Earth where the artifact was originally from.", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The limits of human potential are basically bounded by the limits of human attention.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I almost wrote the whole book on a couple paragraphs from the Pyramid Texts. That's how rich the information is from our past.", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "How continents apart do you have two false doors that both mean the exact same thing, built with the same dimensions to follow the sun, to create the calendar of the sun?", "author": "Jason Quitt", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/71bee0cb-99ee-4785-ba9d-5d867e75cbbe/JASON-QUITT.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "History is only ever going to be a story, never going to be something that we can open a magic portal and go look at it in person in the actual moment it occurred.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I honestly think studying astrotheology and all the various subcomponents and different branches and tunnels in the rabbit hole literally will make you more intelligent because it's training your pattern recognition.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
